Paper accepted for GeoInformatics 2012

A paper on „An Immersive Visualization System for Virtual 3D City Models” by Juri Engel, Sebastian Pasewaldt, Matthias Trapp, and Jürgen Döllner has been accepted as a full paper by GeoInformatics 2012, which will be held in Hong Kong from 15-17 June, 2012.
